protocol.selection: minimum mean parent-validation NLL, no final test data generated or evaluated in this mechanism pilot
protocol.evaluation: Exact source-parent uniform fixed coordinates retained inside observed SNP coverage of Relate-inferred genealogies. Original query order and global coordinates are preserved. No chromosome-tail extrapolation.
protocol.interpretation: Paired 64-query exploratory inferred cohort. Exactly the new independent oracle parents. No final test generation or performance/novelty claim.
protocol.comparison_note: Independent simulation seeds relative to all earlier datasets. The same fixed observed-reference adapter is prepared. Boundary studies will reuse these parents only through a separately hash-bound frozen preparation.

source_parent.split_policy: Same 16 train and4 validation larger-query parents, no test.

inference.seed_scheme: SHA256 UTF-8 ARG-GNN/Relate/v1.2.4/{master_seed}/{split}/{replicate}; first 8 bytes unsigned big endian modulo (2**31-1), plus 1
inference.coverage_policy: [first exported original SNP, last exported original SNP + 1); exact original grid only
inference.genotype_source: Cleaned parent observed.trees.gz only, never raw census truth.
inference.polarization: Simulated ancestral allele at observed mutation sites only; no invented ancestor FASTA

source_parent.split_policy: Same 16 train and4 validation larger-query parents, no test.

relate_installation.checksum_kind: locally computed SHA256 of official HTTPS archive, not an upstream signed digest

authorization.scope: research use only; no external redistribution
